definitions.explanation: A quality of grace, tastefulness, or class.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}を{並|なら}べる。
{食品|しょくひん}の{安全性|あんぜんせい}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Food product safety has become an issue.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{部品|ぶひん}が{多|おお}くて{組|く}み{立|た}てが{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: This product has many parts, so assembly is difficult.
They are a person of refinement.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{品|ひん}のある{話|はな}し{方|かた}をする。
examples.english: She speaks in a refined manner.

examples.japanese: あの{店|みせ}は{料理|りょうり}もおいしいし、{品|ひん}のある{雰囲気|ふんいき}で{気|き}に{入|い}っている。
examples.english: That restaurant has delicious food and a refined atmosphere, so I like it.

notes:
Has two distinct usages: as a suffix for goods/items, and as a standalone word meaning elegance.

AS SUFFIX (goods):
・{食品|しょくひん} (food products)
・{商品|しょうひん} (merchandise)
・{製品|せいひん} (manufactured goods)
・{部品|ぶひん} (parts, components)
・{作品|さくひん} (work, creation)

AS STANDALONE (elegance):
・{品|ひん}がある (to have refinement)
・{品|ひん}がいい (refined, classy)
・{品|ひん}がない (lacking refinement, vulgar)
・{品|ひん}を{落|お}とす (to lower one's dignity)

NOTE:
・When read as しな, it typically means "item, article" in a more concrete sense
